String.name: Thrall Augmentation
String.tooltip:
[EN] [Effect] Toggle Skill$BRWhile activated, using a summon skill summons enhanced thralls that grants beneficial effects to nearby allies.$BR$BR[Enhanced Thrall Effects]$BRThrall of Protection: Grants a shield that absorbs 30,000 $calcValue(multiple,1004,0.5,0) HP for 12 seconds with immunity to knock-down and stagger while the shield is active.$BRAbsorbed amount of damage increases by $H_S_GOOD50%$COLOR_END of your Magic Resistance. Costs additional 340 MP.$BR$BRThrall of Life: Removes harmful effects cast on nearby allies. For 5 seconds, increases Movement Speed in combat by 10, and instantly heals $calcValue(heal,0,3105,0) HP of your ally and replenishes 773 MP per second. Costs additional 300 MP.$BR$BRThrall of Vengeance: Increases $BRPower by 15$calcValue(multiple,1004,0.0001,0) for 12 seconds (This effect increases as your Magic Resistance increases). Effect ends if $BRknocked-down$BR$BR. Costs additional 700 MP. Thrall of Wrath: Increases $BRCrit Power by 0.6$calcValue(multiple,1004,0.000002,1) times for 20 seconds. This effect is increased based on your Magic Resistance. Effect ends if knocked-down. Costs additional 1000 MP.$BR$BR[Skill Usage]$BRActivate the skill effect, then summon a thrall near allies.
[ES] [Efecto] Toggle Skill$BRMientras esté activo, usar una habilidad de invocación invoca thralls mejorados que otorgan efectos beneficiosos a los aliados cercanos.$BR$BR[Enhanced Thrall Effects]$BRThrall of Protection: Otorga un escudo que absorbe 30.000 $calcValue(multiple,1004,0.5,0) HP durante 12 segundos con inmunidad al derribo y tambaleo mientras el escudo esté activo.$BRLa cantidad de daño absorbido aumenta en el $H_S_GOOD50%$COLOR_END de tu resistencia mágica. Cuesta 340 MP adicionales.$BR$BRThrall of Life: Elimina los efectos dañinos aplicados a los aliados cercanos. Durante 5 segundos, aumenta la velocidad de movimiento en combate en 10 e inmediatamente cura $calcValue(heal,0,3105,0) HP de tu aliado y recupera 773 MP por segundo. Cuesta 300 MP adicionales.$BR$BRThrall of Vengeance: Aumenta el $BRpoder en 15$calcValue(multiple,1004,0.0001,0) durante 12 segundos (este efecto aumenta a medida que aumenta tu resistencia mágica). El efecto termina si eres $BRderribado$BR$BR. Cuesta 700 MP adicionales. Thrall of Wrath: Aumenta el $BRpoder de golpe crítico en 0,6$calcValue(multiple,1004,0.000002,1) veces durante 20 segundos. Este efecto aumenta según tu resistencia mágica. El efecto termina si eres derribado. Cuesta 1000 MP adicionales.$BR$BR[Uso de habilidad]$BRActiva el efecto de la habilidad y luego invoca un thrall cerca de los aliados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon: Elemental God
String.tooltip:
[EN] [Effect] Summon Skill$BRSummon the Elemental God in front of you. Recovers HP of nearby allies to maximum and grants a shield.$BRDeals great damage to nearby enemies as the God hops around in a circle.$BR$BR[Skill Limits] $BRSummoning a Thrall of Vengeance or Thrall of Wrath will cancel Elemental God.$BR$BR[Skill Usage]$BRPress the skill button while facing summon location.
[ES] [Efecto] Summon Skill$BRInvoca al Dios Elemental frente a ti. Recupera el HP de los aliados cercanos al máximo y otorga un escudo.$BRInflige un gran daño a los enemigos cercanos mientras el Dios da saltos en círculos.$BR$BR[Skill Limits] $BRInvocar un Thrall of Vengeance o Thrall of Wrath cancelará al Dios Elemental.$BR$BR[Uso de habilidad]$BRPresiona el botón de la habilidad mientras miras hacia la ubicación de invocación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Arunic Release
String.tooltip:
[EN] [Effect]$BRExplode a maximum of 4 motes ahead of you. String.name: Obliteration
String.tooltip:
[EN] [Effect] Laser Targeting$BRWith the Modular Weapon System active, leap into the air and unleash a devastating missile barrage. You are immune to damage while in the air.$BR$BR[Enhance Skill]$BRAll your attacks have double the normal chance to crit and are considered to be attacks from behind for a few seconds.$BR$BR[Focused Willpower]$BRRecover 40 Willpower per successful missile hit.$BR$BR[Skill Usage]$BRUnleash a devastating missile barrage 10m ahead of you to generate Arcane Splash.
[ES] [Efecto] Laser Targeting$BRCon el Modular Weapon System activo, salta en el aire y desata una devastadora lluvia de misiles. Eres inmune al daño mientras estás en el aire.$BR$BR[Enhance Skill]$BRTodos tus ataques tienen el doble de la probabilidad normal de golpe crítico y se consideran ataques por la espalda durante unos segundos.$BR$BR[Focused Willpower]$BRRecupera 40 de Willpower por cada impacto exitoso de misil.$BR$BR[Uso de habilidad]$BRDesata una devastadora lluvia de misiles a 10m frente a ti para generar Arcane Splash.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.tooltip:

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Flight: Ancient Mighty Tyflamosaurus Flex
String.tooltip:
[EN] $H_S_GOODFlying Speed: 290; Flying Duration: 694; Speed: 290; Mounted Effects: HP/MP Regeneration$COLOR_END$BR[General Flight Capability: 157]$BR$BRSummon Tyflamosaurus Flex $H_S_GOODwith its high flying speed and duration$COLOR_END. Restores 2% of your max HP and MP every second. Additionally, you can use the skill Raptor Gift (Crafting), which grants you increased crafting speed. The Explosaurus passive effect does not overlap with the passive effects of other legendary fabled creatures.
[ES] $H_S_GOODVelocidad de vuelo: 290; Duración de vuelo: 694; Velocidad: 290; Efectos montado: Regeneración de HP/MP$COLOR_END$BR[Capacidad general de vuelo: 157]$BR$BRInvoca a Tyflamosaurus Flex $H_S_GOODcon su alta velocidad y duración de vuelo$COLOR_END. El efecto pasivo de Explosaurus no se superpone con los efectos pasivos de otras criaturas legendarias de fábula.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] $H_S_GOODMovement Speed 280.$COLOR_END$BRSummon a battle lion. This mount can be ridden in normal and Civil Unrest zones.
[ES] $H_S_GOODVelocidad de movimiento: 280.$COLOR_END$BRInvoca un león de batalla. Esta montura se puede montar en zonas normales y de conflicto civil (Civil Unrest).
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon : Skydancer (30days)
String.tooltip:
[EN] $H_S_GOODMovement Speed 280; Flight Speed 270.$COLOR_END$BR$BRSummon Skydancer, a flying mount.
[ES] $H_S_GOODVelocidad de movimiento: 280; Velocidad de vuelo: 270.$COLOR_END$BR$BRInvoca a Skydancer, una montura voladora.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Kick
String.tooltip:
[EN] Kick the rolling haybale to move it around the playing area. And by "kick" we mean whack it with a ball.
[ES] Patea la paca de heno rodante para moverla por el área de juego. Y con "patear" nos referimos a golpearla con una pelota.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Pig Pheromone
String.tooltip:
[EN] Throw pheromones at a pigling from $maxDistance or less to make it follow you.
[ES] Lanza feromonas a un pigling desde $maxDistance o menos para que te siga.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Drum Beat
String.tooltip:
[EN] Aim and hit a toad drum within $maxDistance to play it.
[ES] Apunta y golpea un tambor de sapo dentro de $maxDistance para tocarlo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: {@RawItem:45292}

String.tooltip:
[EN] Throws a plant.

String.name: Free Flight
String.tooltip:
[EN] $H_S_GOODSpeed: 290/290$COLOR_END$BRUse a special costume such as the IM39 Prototype to fly without a mount.
[ES] $H_S_GOODVelocidad: 290/290$COLOR_END$BRUsa un atuendo especial como el IM39 Prototype para volar sin una montura.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Landing
String.tooltip:
[EN] Deactivates free flight.

No guarantee of a soft landing.
[ES] Desactiva el vuelo libre.

Sin garantía de un aterrizaje suave.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Alkaline Water Bomb
String.tooltip:
[EN] Throw an Alkaline Water Bomb to remove the Acidic Field.
[ES] Lanza una bomba de agua alcalina para eliminar el campo ácido.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Alkaline Water Bomb Mode
String.tooltip:
[EN] Cancel Alkaline Water Bomb mode.
[ES] Cancela el modo de bomba de agua alcalina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Personalized Greeting
String.tooltip:
[EN] Say hello in your own unique style—tell a joke, sing a song, spout poetry (up to 40 characters in length). Recipients of your greetings get some pep to their step. < >Edit your greeting messages via the 'Change Greeting' button in the Details section of the Skills menu (K).
[ES] Saluda con tu propio estilo único: cuenta un chiste, canta una canción, recita poesía (de hasta 40 caracteres de longitud). Quienes reciban tus saludos obtendrán un impulso de energía. < >Edita tus mensajes de saludo mediante el botón 'Cambiar saludo' en la sección de detalles del menú de habilidades (K).
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon Group
String.tooltip:
[EN] TERA Rewards skill: Teleport all group members within the same province to your side. You cannot teleport group members who are in other provinces.
[ES] Habilidad de TERA Rewards: teletransporta a todos los miembros del grupo en la misma provincia a tu lado. No puedes teletransportar a miembros del grupo que estén en otras provincias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon NPC: Phargo
String.tooltip:
[EN] TERA Rewards skill: Summons a traveling banker for you and your group.
[ES] Habilidad de TERA Rewards: invoca un banquero ambulante para ti y tu grupo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Elemental Fire
String.tooltip:
[EN] Pushes back and burns enemies in a spray of flame.
[ES] Empuja hacia atrás y quema a los enemigos con un chorro de llamas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Elemental Ice
String.tooltip:
[EN] Pushes back enemies within $maxDistance. Will freeze enemies in place after 10 seconds.
[ES] Empuja hacia atrás a los enemigos en un radio de $maxDistance. Congelará a los enemigos en su lugar después de 10 segundos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Elemental Muck
String.tooltip:
[EN] Summon a circle of muck 10m in front of you. Decreases Movement Speed and drains HP of enemies.
[ES] Invoca un círculo de lodo a 10m frente a ti. Reduce la velocidad de movimiento y drena el HP de los enemigos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Elemental Blast
String.tooltip:
[EN] Fires a bolt of damaging energy up to $maxDistance.
[ES] Dispara un proyectil de energía dañina a una distancia de hasta $maxDistance.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Darkan's Wings
String.tooltip:
[EN] [TERA Rewards Exclusive] Summon a pair of draconic wings to impress friends and foes alike.
Skill is canceled upon entering combat. Darkan's Wings do not grant the ability to fly.
[ES] [Exclusivo de TERA Rewards] Invoca un par de alas dracónicas para impresionar a amigos y enemigos por igual.
La habilidad se cancela al entrar en combate. Las Darkan's Wings no otorgan la capacidad de volar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Darkan's Blue Wings
String.tooltip:
[EN] Focuses your inner power and gives you burning wings. The effect disappears if you are hit or inflict damage.
[ES] Concentra tu Focus interior y te otorga alas ardientes. El efecto desaparece si recibes un golpe o infliges daño.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Darkan's Green Wings
String.tooltip:
[EN] Focuses your inner power and gives you burning wings. The effect disappears if you are hit or inflict damage.
[ES] Concentra tu Focus interior y te otorga alas ardientes. El efecto desaparece si recibes un golpe o infliges daño.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Darkan's Black Wings
String.tooltip:
[EN] Focuses your inner power and gives you burning wings. The effect disappears if you are hit or inflict damage.
[ES] Concentra tu Focus interior y te otorga alas ardientes. El efecto desaparece si recibes un golpe o infliges daño.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Darkan's Pink Wings
String.tooltip:
[EN] Focuses your inner power and gives you burning wings. The effect disappears if you are hit or inflict damage.
[ES] Concentra tu Focus interior y te otorga alas ardientes. El efecto desaparece si recibes un golpe o infliges daño.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Moon Lotus Aura
String.tooltip:
[EN] Activate the Moon Lotus Aura to sheath yourself in a gleaming aura for 30 seconds and receive the Moon Lotus Blessing for 15 minutes.

$H_W_GOOD[Effect]$COLOR_ENDCompletely restores your HP and MP, increases your attack speed by $H_W_GOOD3$COLOR_END and your movement speed in combat by $H_W_GOOD5$COLOR_END.

$H_W_BADBlessing cooldown: 30 minutes$COLOR_END
$H_W_BADAura cooldown: 5 seconds$COLOR_END

The aura disappears when you enter combat, the blessing remains.
[ES] Activa el Moon Lotus Aura para envolverte en un aura brillante durante 30 segundos y recibe el Moon Lotus Blessing durante 15 minutos.

$H_W_GOOD[Efecto]$COLOR_ENDRestaura por completo tu HP y MP, aumenta tu velocidad de ataque en $H_W_GOOD3$COLOR_END y tu velocidad de movimiento en combate en $H_W_GOOD5$COLOR_END.

$H_W_BADCooldown de la bendición: 30 minutos$COLOR_END
$H_W_BADCooldown del aura: 5 segundos$COLOR_END

El aura desaparece cuando entras en combate, la bendición permanece.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Mutate (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Turns a target within $maxDistance into a warthog that will fight for you. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Convierte a un objetivo dentro de $maxDistance en un jabalí que luchará por ti. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Stun (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Stuns targets within $maxDistance temporarily. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Aturde temporalmente a los objetivos dentro de $maxDistance. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Fear (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Frightens targets within $maxDistance. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Asusta a los objetivos dentro de $maxDistance. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Light (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Summons Balder's lamp $maxDistance in front of you. Balder's lamp kills monsters within 8m. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Invoca la lámpara de Balder $maxDistance frente a ti. La lámpara de Balder mata a los monstruos dentro de 8m. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Punish (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Inflicts great damage on a target within $maxDistance. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Inflige gran daño a un objetivo dentro de $maxDistance. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Quake (Balder's Gift)
String.tooltip:
[EN] Knocks down targets within $maxDistance. A temporary skill given to you from the clerics of Balder to battle the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Derriba a los objetivos dentro de $maxDistance. Una habilidad temporal otorgada por los clérigos de Balder para combatir en el Banquet of Blood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Repel
String.tooltip:
[EN] Project a cone of oneiric energy that pushes nearby enemies $maxDistance away.
[ES] Proyecta un cono de energía onírica que empuja a los enemigos cercanos $maxDistance hacia atrás.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Inexorable Pull
String.tooltip:
[EN] Drags all the enemies within $maxDistance toward you.
[ES] Arrastra hacia ti a todos los enemigos dentro de $maxDistance.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Human Cannonball
String.tooltip:
[EN] Get engulfed in flame and fly 13m straight ahead and knocks down every target in your way and cause some damage.
[ES] Envuélvete en llamas y vuela 13m en línea recta hacia adelante, derribando a todos los objetivos en tu camino y causando algo de daño.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Rising Wind
String.tooltip:
[EN] Creates a cyclone that flings all enemies within $maxDistance up in the air.
[ES] Crea un ciclón que lanza por los aires a todos los enemigos dentro de $maxDistance.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Oneiric Lance
String.tooltip:
[EN] Hold down the skill button to deal damage to all targets in the path of the effect.
[ES] Mantén presionado el botón de la habilidad para infligir daño a todos los objetivos en la trayectoria del efecto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Dream Bolt
String.tooltip:
[EN] Project a blast of oneiric energy at an enemy up to $maxDistance away.
[ES] Proyecta una ráfaga de energía onírica a un enemigo a una distancia de hasta $maxDistance.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Hush!
String.tooltip:
[EN] You cannot use any skills or items during the event!
Thank you for your cooperation! -Popori Club-
[ES] ¡No puedes usar ninguna habilidad ni objeto durante el evento!
¡Gracias por tu cooperación! -Popori Club-
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Rampage I
String.tooltip:
[EN] Rage Skill$BR Rush the enemy from up to 24m away and deliver a series of devastating blows.$BRProvides excellent defense, knocks monsters into the air (does not affect other players), and increases your Rage.
[ES] Rage Skill$BR Embiste al enemigo desde una distancia de hasta 24m y asesta una serie de golpes devastadores.$BRProporciona una excelente defensa, lanza a los monstruos por los aires (no afecta a otros jugadores) y aumenta tu Rage.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Snow Barrage
String.tooltip:
[EN] Hold and charge the skill button to prepare and throw a number of snowballs with increasing damage.
[ES] Mantén presionado y carga el botón de la habilidad para preparar y lanzar varias bolas de nieve con daño incrementado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Set Us Up, Da Bomb
String.tooltip:
[EN] Blow yourself up, dealing damage to objects and enemies around you.
[ES] Hazte explotar, infligiendo daño a los objetos y enemigos a tu alrededor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon: Felicity
String.tooltip:
[EN] Use this manual to learn how to summon the cute Ser Picks-a-lot with a 72-slot tab of [special storage] and special emotes. He has the ability to gather ores, plants and essences at an enhanced speed, consuming 20% fewer production points.
[ES] Usa este manual para aprender a invocar al adorable Ser Picks-a-lot con una pestaña de [special storage] de 72 espacios y emotes especiales. Tiene la habilidad de recolectar minerales, plantas y esencias a una velocidad mejorada, consumiendo un 20% menos de puntos de producción.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon Pet: Wooley
String.tooltip:
[EN] Summon your pet with the ability to [auto-loot].
[ES] Invoca a tu mascota con la habilidad de [auto-loot].
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Summon Pet: Candyspinner
String.tooltip:
[EN] Summon your pet with the ability to [auto-loot].
[ES] Invoca a tu mascota con la habilidad de [auto-loot].
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Angler's Greeting
String.tooltip:
[EN] Say hello in the old angler style.
Skill will be used automatically during auto-fishing. Edit your greeting messages via the 'Change Greeting' button in the Details section of the Skills menu.
[ES] Saluda al viejo estilo de pescador.
La habilidad se usará automáticamente durante la pesca automática. Edita tus mensajes de saludo mediante el botón 'Change Greeting' en la sección de detalles del menú Skills.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Un-zombify
String.tooltip:
[EN] Cancels zombification.
[ES] Cancela la zombificación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Un-zombify
String.tooltip:
[EN] Cancels zombification.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Velik's Horn
String.tooltip:
[EN] Teleport to Velika.
[ES] Teletransportarse a Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Location Scan
String.tooltip:
[EN] Foes in an area around your current location are exposed to allies for a while.
[ES] Los enemigos en un área alrededor de tu ubicación actual quedan expuestos ante los aliados durante un tiempo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Meteor
String.tooltip:
[EN] Cast a series of balls of flame on an area within a range, damaging both allies and opponents.
[ES] Lanza una serie de bolas de fuego en un área dentro de un rango, causando daño tanto a los aliados como a los oponentes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Commander's Blessing
String.tooltip:
[EN] Restore 2% of total MP every second for 15 seconds of up to 10 allies in an area within range.
[ES] Restaura el 2% del MP total cada segundo durante 15 segundos a un máximo de 10 aliados en un área dentro del rango.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Commander's Salvation
String.tooltip:
[EN] Heal 40% of total HP of up to 10 allies at once in an area within range.
[ES] Cura el 40% del HP total de hasta 10 aliados a la vez en un área dentro del rango.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.name: Commander's Blessing
String.tooltip:
[EN] Restore 2% of total MP every second for 15 seconds of up to 10 allies in an area within range.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

String.tooltip:
[EN] Cast a series of balls of flame on an area within a range, damaging opponents and decreasing their Movement Speed by 50%.
[ES] Lanza una serie de bolas de fuego en un área dentro de un rango, causando daño a los oponentes y reduciendo su velocidad de movimiento en un 50%.
